description:
## What
Add acceptance tests for NameConstraints using PKITS §4.13 test vectors in pkix-path/tests/.

## Algorithm
Use the existing PKITS helper infrastructure (pkits_helper.rs) and the cert files already present in tests/pkits/certs/.

Cover all 38 PKITS §4.13 sub-tests:
- §4.13.1–4.13.5: Valid/invalid path with permitted DN subtrees
- §4.13.6–4.13.11: Valid/invalid path with excluded DN subtrees
- §4.13.12–4.13.14: Permitted subtrees (RFC 822 names)
- §4.13.15–4.13.17: Excluded subtrees (RFC 822 names)
- §4.13.18–4.13.20: Permitted + excluded combination
- §4.13.21–4.13.26: RFC 822 name constraints
- §4.13.27–4.13.29: DN + RFC 822 combined
- §4.13.30–4.13.33, §4.13.38: DNS name constraints
- §4.13.34–4.13.37: URI constraints (if implemented; mark ignored if not)

Each test: load cert chain, call validate_path with PKITS_NOW, assert Ok or Err(NameConstraintViolation).

## Test oracle
PKITS §4.13 specifies which sub-tests must pass (valid paths) and which must fail.
All cert files are in tests/pkits/certs/ (confirmed present in research phase).

## Acceptance criteria
- All PKITS §4.13 valid-path tests return Ok
- All PKITS §4.13 invalid-path tests return Err(pkix_path::Error::NameConstraintViolation { .. })
- No tests skipped unless URI support is explicitly out of scope for v0.1
- Depends on: PKIX-fr4 (wire-in)
title: Add PKITS §4.13 name constraints acceptance tests
